title: Sales Call Summary
content:
Summarise this sales call for a CRM record. Be concise and factual — this is read later by someone who was not on the call.

## Attendees
Who was on the call, and their role or company where stated.

## What was discussed
The main topics, in the order they came up. Two or three sentences each at most.

## Requirements and pain points
What the customer said they need, and what is currently causing them problems. Quote them where the wording matters.

## Objections and concerns
Anything raised as a blocker — price, timing, integration, a competitor, internal approval. Note how it was handled, if it was.

## Commercials mentioned
Any figures, products, discounts, contract lengths or renewal dates discussed. If none, say so.

## Decision makers
Who was named as involved in the decision, and who has the budget, if stated.

## Agreed next steps
One line per action: what, who owns it, and by when. Only include what was actually agreed, not what you think should happen.

## Sentiment
One of Positive, Neutral or Negative, with one sentence of justification.

If something in this template was not covered on the call, write "Not discussed" under that heading rather than leaving it out or guessing.
